adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (unified multimodal memory system discovered through autonomous experiments) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries, relinking or reindexing of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
